description: Heard the third tread from the copper, and left the water on the landing.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Heard the stair, kept her verdict, and sent him out with the crust uneaten.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: On the third tread, and stepped over. Not at the board.
name: Gib

description: Said the back was eased, ate three bites, and went as billed.
name: William Shakespeare
